details.name: The Berber Dynasties
details.summary: Berber mill, lumber camp and mining camp material remixes
details.author: hossein81 and marcokistan
details.description: Native stock economic buildings repainted with warm earth, dark timber and woven surfaces. Original geometry, construction states and player-colour layers retained. Accepted 0.2.4 house, tent, Tuareg and existing gameplay preserved.
details.changelog: Three economic building material remixes with private native stamps and tier bindings. Complete assemblies and stock age progression retained; all unrelated baseline resources preserved.
